name: Banner
summary: A full-width message strip at the top of a page or app, for maintenance, a trial ending or a new feature, with optional actions and a dismiss button.
description: Use a banner for news about the whole site or account. For a message about one form or card use an alert, and for a quick confirmation use a toast.

classes.name: v-banner
classes.description: The strip: an icon, the body, optional actions and an optional dismiss button. Info tone by default.

classes.name: v-banner-body
classes.description: The message; a <strong> inside leads it.

classes.name: v-banner-actions
classes.description: A row of small buttons or links.

classes.name: v-banner-dismiss
classes.description: The close button, kept in the top end corner however the rest wraps.

states.description: Interrupts, only when the message is urgent.

hooks.name: data-v-dismissable
hooks.description: Marks the container that a dismiss button removes.

hooks.name: data-v-dismiss
hooks.description: Removes the container on click and moves focus to the next control.

hooks.name: data-v-dismiss-key
hooks.description: Remembers the dismissal in storage, so the banner is removed on later visits too.

events.name: v:dismiss
events.description: Fires before the banner is removed. Call preventDefault() to keep it.

keyboard.action: Moves to the actions and the dismiss button.
Dismisses the banner when the close button has focus; focus moves on to the next control.

a11y: The dismiss button is an icon button, so it needs aria-label="Dismiss".
After a dismissal focus goes to the next control on the page, not back to the top.
The tone is backed by the icon and the words; never rely on the colour alone.
Use role="alert" sparingly; most banners are role="status" or no role at all when they load with the page.

examples.title: Dismissible
examples.description: Press the cross: the banner goes and focus moves on.
